enum T_SIMP_READ_TYPE

SIMP client read type.

Values:

enumerator SIMP_READ_V1_READ

Read type for simp_ble_client_read_by_handle and simp_ble_client_read_by_uuid to read V1 characteristic value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback. The structure of read result data is T_SIMP_READ_VALUE.

enumerator SIMP_READ_V3_NOTIFY_CCCD

Read type for simp_ble_client_read_by_handle and simp_ble_client_read_by_uuid to read V3 CCCD value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback.

enumerator SIMP_READ_V4_INDICATE_CCCD

Read type for simp_ble_client_read_by_handle and simp_ble_client_read_by_uuid to read V4 CCCD value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback.

enum T_SIMP_WRTIE_TYPE

SIMP client write type.

Values:

enumerator SIMP_WRITE_V2_WRITE

Response write type for simp_ble_client_write_v2_char to write V2 characteristic value.

enumerator SIMP_WRITE_V3_NOTIFY_CCCD

Response write type for simp_ble_client_set_v3_notify to write V3 CCCD.

enumerator SIMP_WRITE_V4_INDICATE_CCCD

Response write type for simp_ble_client_set_v4_ind to write V4 CCCD.

enum T_SIMP_NOTIF_IND_TYPE

SIMP client notification/indication receive type.

Values:

enumerator SIMP_V3_NOTIFY

Notification for V3 characteristic from remote device. The structure of notification data is T_SIMP_NOTIF_IND_VALUE.

enumerator SIMP_V4_INDICATE

Indication for V4 characteristic from remote device. The structure of indication data is T_SIMP_NOTIF_IND_VALUE.

enum T_SIMP_CLIENT_CB_TYPE

SIMP client callback type.

Values:

enumerator SIMP_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_DISC_STATE

Discovery procedure state, done or pending.

enumerator SIMP_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_READ_RESULT

Read request's result data, responded from server.

enumerator SIMP_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_WRITE_RESULT

Write result, success or fail.

enumerator SIMP_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_NOTIF_IND_RESULT

Notification or indication data received from server.

enumerator SIMP_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_INVALID

Invalid callback type, no practical usage.
